title: Understanding the Regularization Function
text: The regularization function is given by Pow(theta)=lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}. This function adds a penalty to the objective function to prevent overfitting.

title: Objective Function Components
text: The objective function consists of two parts: the L2 loss and the regularization term. The L2 loss is given by (1/n)*||Y-X*theta||_2**2, and the regularization term is lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}.

title: Role of Lambda
text: The lambda parameter controls the strength of the regularization. A larger lambda increases the penalty on larger theta values, encouraging smaller coefficients.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Given the objective function (1/n)*||Y-X*theta||_2**2+lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}, determine if the statement about the function being minimized is true.
